steps.describes: Prepares the THP-101 data: absolute dose in mg, one row per sample, one row per subject.
steps.rationale: The project's prepare script unchanged, so the population model starts from the same pk.csv as the other THP-101 analysis.

steps.describes: NCA per subject with the linear-up / log-down trapezoid; terminal half-life from the last three samples.
steps.rationale: The decline is exponential: the log-down trapezoid does not overestimate the AUC there as the linear one does.

steps.describes: run001: one compartment, first-order absorption and elimination (SSfol), random effects on Ka and Cl.
steps.rationale: The structural model the SAP names; the base for any covariate.

steps.describes: run002: run001 with weight as an allometric covariate on clearance, CL = CL70·(WT/70)^0.75, on the absolute dose.
steps.rationale: Weight on clearance is the question of the development plan; allometric scaling with a fixed exponent instead of the linear regression of individual clearances.

steps.describes: Goodness of fit of the final model run001: observed against individual prediction, normalised residuals over time.
steps.rationale: run002 did not improve the fit (AIC 383.9 against 366.0): run001 stays the final model.

claims.why: allometric weight (run002) did not improve the AIC: 383.9 vs 366.0
